dispatch_note.text: HUD-side dispatch fully located (supersedes the earlier derived/candidate text): HUD = gameObj 0x47EF18 + 0x2A548C; captions = hud+0x567c..hud+0x6108, 16 slots, stride 0xB4. (1) Per-frame render 0x4294E0 (main-loop call @0x41C0F7) -> caption paint loop 0x42954B-0x429564: lea edi,[esi+0x567c]; mov ebx,0x10; L: mov eax,[edi]; mov ecx,edi; call [eax+4] (=vtable+4 = 0x417640); add edi,0xB4; dec ebx; jne L. (2) Main input layer calls the three HUD dispatchers directly: move @0x41D457 -> 0x42C510, press @0x41D57B -> 0x42BA20, release @0x41DC82 -> 0x42BE20 (mouse coords = main+0x35B2A8/x, main+0x35B2AC/y). Move tail -> caption move loop 0x42C770: add esi,0x567c; mov ebp,0x10; L: mov edx,[esi]; push edi(y); push ebx(x); mov ecx,esi; call [edx+8] (=0x417780); add esi,0xB4; dec ebp; jne L; xor eax,eax; ret 8 (hover-only, never consumed). Press loop 0x42BAC9: lea ebp,[esi+0x567c]; call [vtable+0xC] (=0x4177C0), first nonzero hit consumed (ret 1). Release loop 0x42BF02: counter [esp+0x14] 0..0xF, slot = counter*0xB4+0x567c, call [vtable+0x10] (=0x4177F0); nonzero -> per-caption click-action jump table 0x42C494 (16 entries, e.g. 0x42BF37: mov ecx,0x47ef18; call 0x419cc0); loop tail 0x42C359 inc/cmp 0x10/jl 0x42BF02. Handler semantics: move/press PtInRect (IAT 0x4762B4) on hit rect this+0x04; inside && state!=2 -> [0x25]=1 (hover, ret 8) / =2 (pressed, ret 8); release-inside 0x4177F0 -> [0x25]=0 + click sound 0x69 via 0x45AFC0(0x8AB130,0x69,0,0,0), ret 1.

closed_notes.conclusion: Frame 159 is the PRESSED-STATE FRAME ART of a tooltip-only hover-caption control (channel_control_class, vtable 0x4763A8, ctor 0x417550) at hud+0x5b68. Primary-static: ctor 0x417550 @0x427B24 stores frame=159->+0x18, state_frame=159->+0x1C, normal override -1->+0x20 (0x4176A9..0x4176B7 arg pushes decoded from the 9-arg thiscall, ret 0x24), paint 0x417640 state machine: normal [+0x25]==0 -> [+0x20]==-1 draws NOTHING (0x417657 je 0x41776F); hover [+0x25]==1 -> [+0x30]==0 -> frame [+0x20]==-1 skipped (0x4176D1 je 0x417719), then text drawn via 0x417370; pressed [+0x25]==2 -> SelectFrame(+0x1C)=159 composite via 0x460240. Mouse handlers: hover 0x417780 (PtInRect IAT 0x4762B4 on hit rect this+0x04), press 0x4177C0 (state=2; release-inside plays sound 0x69 via 0x45AFC0 on 0x8AB130), release 0x4177F0 resets. Therefore Frame 159 is NOT a permanently visible belt label and NOT a text glyph; it is transient pressed-state art of an otherwise-invisible caption control (the visible label is the hover-only cursor-following GBK text). Frame 159 bitmap itself is real (16x14, 153 opaque px, 115 colors).

Draw-time path for the constructor-associated strings (all 8 HUD captions, hover state only): 0x417370 entry @0x417719 <- 0x417640 hover branch; GetCursorPos (IAT 0x476240) -> ScreenToClient (IAT 0x476234) on hWnd [0x8AB7B0] (main game window handle - corrects the earlier 'font object 0x8AB7B0' note) -> POINT cache 0x8B1880/0x8B1884; GBK string cache 0x8B1888 with dirty flag 0x47ADBC and typewriter counter 0x47ADC0 (reveal rect top = cy - counter, region grows to (w+12) x (h+4); completion resets dirty=0, counter=6); measure via 0x45E0C0 on render context 0x8AB7A8 (font object = [ctx+0x28]); clip via CreateRectRgn (IAT 0x476054) + GetRgnBox (IAT 0x47604C); box fill 0x45E570(0, &rect, 0x96FFFF, 2) = CreateSolidBrush(0x96FFFF) (IAT 0x476064) + FillRect (IAT 0x4762F0) = light yellow RGB(255,255,150); 1px black border 0x45E570(0, &rect, 0, 1) = CreateSolidBrush(0) + FrameRect (IAT 0x4762F4); text 0x45DE50 = SetBkMode(TRANSPARENT) (IAT 0x476044) + SelectObject(font=[ctx 0x8AB7A8+0x28]) (IAT 0x476048) + SetTextColor (IAT 0x476060) + DrawTextA (IAT 0x476280) flags 0x25 = DT_SINGLELINE|DT_VCENTER|DT_CENTER + restore + surface composite [vtable+0x68]; DeleteObject x3 per frame (HRGN + 2 brushes, IAT 0x476068).
